name: @sos-2/ide-bridge
description: SOS 2.0 IDE Bridge (Work Order P11): the OPTIONAL IDE bridge — the §4 tier-4 ('extension') adapter contract bridging an IDE integration onto the companion/harness surface, with the SAME adapter discipline as the browser bridge. Typed ports with INJECTABLE TRANSPORTS (the P8 LocalBridgeTransport command-dispatch precedent): every command is dispatched with a JSON body over an injectable IdeBridgeTransport and every reply is validated against the operation's exact typed shape — a malformed reply is a truthful FAILED result, never a silent success. THE SEAM CARRIES NO AUTHORITY: every marshaled request/reply is validated against an EXACT field set; a smuggled grant/permission/authority key is a typed violation NAMING the field (browser/IDE extensions are ADAPTERS, never SOS authorities — pinned by tests). Honest connection statuses consumed from the merged P8 vocabulary: NOT_YET_CONNECTED while no real IDE integration exists (connection evidence is never fabricated) with the explicit simulated marker when the deterministic reference transport backs the bridge. NO real IDE plugin ships in this Work Order: provider-neutral contracts plus a LOCAL REFERENCE RUNTIME (deterministic, offline-testable); real IDE plugins attach later through the same transports without contract change.
